title: Affine-local cohomology of derived tensor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P,N$ complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with $P$ K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and $Q(P),Q(N)$ having quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. For an affine open $U\subset X$ and $n\in\mathbb Z$, the restriction to $U$ of $H^n(Q(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)))$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Tag 08DX, perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, proof of (1) using (2), and Tag 06Z0

proof.text:
exact restriction commutes with cohomology and with the total tensor of complexes,
and preserves K-flatness. On the affine U, represent the restrictions of Q(P) and Q(N)
by tilde of module complexes using 06Z0. Resolve the first module complex by a K-flat
complex. The affine tensor comparison identifies the restricted tensor representative
with tilde of the total tensor of this resolution and the second module complex.
Tilde is exact, so every cohomology sheaf is tilde of a module and is quasi-coherent.
Transfer through the derived comparison and the equivalence with the over category.
This works in all degrees, including unbounded complexes and the empty open.
